aboutText: Industrial Electrical Contractors Melbourne, operating as M.A.S.S Electrics, has been a cornerstone of Airport West's industrial community for over 80 years. Director Matthew Puopolo upholds a family tradition that began in the 1940s, ensuring consistent, high-quality electrical work. Our skilled team handles everything from PLC automation to 24-hour emergency breakdowns, serving clients across Melbourne's industrial sector.
servicesText: From PLC programming to emergency repairs, we offer a full range of electrical services tailored for industrial facilities in Airport West and surrounding areas.
